name: 整支生晒参泡煮干货款
description: 整支须根完整生晒参干货：开屏卖点、部位鉴别、泡煮场景与信任收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshots, deep pine green #14372F and cinnabar red #8C2B22 info panels, warm wood boards for scene and detail shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft directional warm key from the front-left with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: light bamboo-wood cutting board #C89B62 and matte dark slate #2F2B27
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and thin gold-frame panels only, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale; whole dried root fully visible in packshots, fine roots never cropped
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tonic-herb ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, deep pine green #14372F, warm ginseng tan #C08A4E and cinnabar red accent #8C2B22; warm studio lighting with soft directional key and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end dried-botanical product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清整支参形态，干净合规赢点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, slight 3/4 angle, whole root upright and fully visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the root fills the clean field
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The whole dried root laid upright and fully visible, straight-on eye-level view at a slight 3/4 angle. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front key with gentle fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the root. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no props. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace needed. 8K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no mould, no unrealistic portion size, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1 整支须根完整的干燥人参加香料平铺竹木砧板，墨绿底金字标题开屏；屏2 深红底九枚花瓣形标签的标签墙，背景为参须特写；屏3 营养倍数对比话术加整参铺拍（干橙片、松果、肉桂卷、红枣道具）；屏4 国标条文引用文字板加好参六招鉴别开头（芦头、参体）；屏5-6 鉴别指南续（人参腿、珍珠点、人参须、环境）逐部位特写；屏7 三个圆形不添加类标签加整参加大蒜特写；屏8 参数表（品名人参、用法泡水煮汤、保存方法置通风处）加食养话术横幅；屏9 产品特写加二维码会员角标与医疗功效话术。品类判定：参数区品名为人参、用法用量为泡水煮汤的整支干燥参须干货，需泡发炖煮而非即食，全页为滋补话术结构，判为医药保健/营养补充；源夹名标注为食品已按图改判。已剥离：地域宣称、野生与年限宣称、国标条文引用、营养倍数对比、医疗功效断言、不添加类话术、规格克重与保存等参数数值、品牌水印、二维码与会员角标、原料与生产两处产地宣称，原文数值一律改为空白 proof 占位或占位符。
